all_violations.description: The old signed-URL absence assertion executes only when previousSignedHref is truthy. Callers at lines 583,611,646 obtain it with getAttribute and only a TypeScript non-null assertion, so a missing href silently omits this check; a visible download element does not prove its href exists. This can pass without exercising the claimed stale capability removal.
all_violations.suggestion: Assert that the prior signed href is nonempty when capturing it, pass a required string to the helper, and execute the absence assertion unconditionally for those cases.

if (previousSignedHref) expect(await page.locator("#main-content").evaluate((element, href) =>
    [...element.querySelectorAll("a")].some(anchor => anchor.href === href), previousSignedHref)).toBe(false);

all_violations.description: The only eligible-person DTO shape assertion is inside a loop over read.eligiblePeople with no nonempty or expected-identity assertion. all_violations.suggestion: Arrange a specifically eligible current member and assert the expected populated eligiblePeople identities before iterating. If a role legitimately receives no candidates, assert that empty outcome explicitly in its own case.

all_violations.description: The child-denial assertion is selected by the observed unrelatedParent response.
